1# function to perform binary search
2def binary_search(lst, target):
3    
4    # set low and high index
5    low = 0
6    high = len(lst) - 1
7    
8    # if low is greater than high,
9    # the element is not found in the list 
10    while low <= high:
11        
12        # find middle element
13        mid = (low + high) // 2
14        
15        # if target value is equal to middle element
16        # return the element
17        if target == lst[mid]:
18            return mid
19        
20        # if target value is less than the middle element
21        # update high to mid - 1 
22        elif target < lst[mid]:
23            high = mid - 1
24        
25        # if target value is less than the middle element
26        # update low to mid + 1 
27        else:
28            low = mid + 1
29    
30    return None
31
32lst = [4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]
33
34# set a target value
35target_value = 7
36
37result = binary_search(lst, target_value)
38
39if result:
40    print(f"Element {target_value} is found at index {result}")
41else:
42    print(f"{target_value} is not found in the list")
